name: SSH MCP Server Configuration
description: Claude Desktop MCP Server configuration for remote Linux server access

ssh-mcp-server.note: SECURITY: Never put SSH passwords in config files. Use .env file or system environment variables.
ssh-mcp-server.env_setup: Create .env file in project root with: SSH_HOST, SSH_PORT, SSH_USER, SSH_PASSWORD, SSH_TIMEOUT

installation_guide.step1: Create .env file in ssh-mcp-server directory with your SSH credentials
installation_guide.step2: Copy the 'ssh-mcp-server' section to your Claude Desktop config
installation_guide.step4: Test with: 'Linux sunucumda sistem bilgilerini göster'

available_tools.name: execute_command
available_tools.description: Execute any shell command on remote server

available_tools.name: file_operations
available_tools.description: Read, write, list files and directories

security_features: Automatic blocking of dangerous commands (rm -rf /, format, etc.)
Process kill operations limited to numeric PIDs only
File operations use safe shell escaping
